heading: Job History
note: A few chapters from the journey

paragraphs: Leading a small product team building dependable tools for independent businesses.
Focused on clear architecture, useful feedback loops, and making complex systems feel approachable.
Built web platforms and APIs used by distributed editorial teams.
Helped simplify delivery practices and mentored engineers across product groups.
Worked across frontend and backend systems for a growing digital studio.
Learned to value small releases, honest documentation, and resilient interfaces.
